column10: The CSV export built the whole file in memory and sent it back as base64 inside JSON so on a form with very many entries or long answers it ran out of memory and failed with a 500 instead of giving a file
column11: The export is streamed from admin-post.php (action subtleforms_export_csv) with a nonce and the manage_options check and written to the response one chunk of 2000 entries at a time. The Export CSV buttons download that address. The JSON route stays for one release and is deprecated.
